thread:
maria: quick question — PR #4321 adds the v2 SDK migration guide + examples. Who needs to review for CODEOWNERS/SDK ownership, and can we enable auto-merge once CI & docs-preview pass? docs-preview has been flaky for me lately.

alex: if the files are under /docs only then docs-team is fine. but SDK snippets under /docs/sdks/ should trigger sdk-team approval. CODEOWNERS currently has `/docs/ @docs-team` I think.

ryan: infra note: we allow auto-merge for docs-only via the `automerge-if-docs` GH Action, but it explicitly blocks if any path matches `/docs/sdks/**`. that needs an SDK owner approval.

maria: got it — so strategy: if this is pure docs we add `docs:only` label and GH Action will auto-merge. if it touches /docs/sdks/ we need @sdk-team review. I'll mark the PR accordingly.

ci-bot: Build started: docs-preview (mkdocs) for PR #4321.

alex: saw the preview fail locally earlier: `Undefined reference: QuickStartSDK` inside `docs/sdks/migration.md` — usually a cross-ref or nav problem. I'll push a tiny fix to the anchor.

maria: also, can we update CODEOWNERS to include `/docs/sdks/ @sdk-team` so future SDK snippets pick up reviewers automatically?

ryan: CODEOWNERS lives at repo root. yeah that's fine — open a tiny PR to update CODEOWNERS. infra doesn't need to gate that change, but we'll review for syntax.

sam: FYI on auto-merge policy: we only auto-merge docs when label `docs:only` is present AND all checks (lint, mkdocs preview) pass and there are no path exceptions (like sdk snippets). the `automerge-if-docs` action checks paths.

maria: plan: 1) alex pushes cross-ref fix 2) I add `docs:only` label if no sdk files changed 3) if /docs/sdks changed, request @sdk-team 4) open CODEOWNERS PR to add `/docs/sdks/ @sdk-team`

alex: pushed the cross-ref fix in a new commit -> can someone retrigger preview?

ci-bot: docs-preview re-run queued... docs-preview succeeded for PR #4321. preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.example  :white_check_mark:

maria: awesome, thanks alex and ci-bot. @ryan I'll open the CODEOWNERS PR in a sec — can you glance when it's up?

ryan: will do. note: even after adding sdk-team to CODEOWNERS, auto-merge will remain blocked until an sdk-team member reviews. that's intended.

sam: if this needs to ship urgently for the v2 release, add `release:patch` and ping me — I can fast-track approval in exceptional cases, but prefer owner review.

maria: sounds good. I'll add a short PR comment explaining the CODEOWNERS change and the plan for auto-merge. merging once approvals and preview are green :shipit:
